symbols.read: Price has pushed through the 722.40 lower pivot to 722.79, so the bearish tilt from the prior read is now neutralized and the invalidated SELL stays dead; the 4H remains Bearish but the 1H trend has flipped up, confirming the fade noted last time has turned into a genuine grind higher. The 718.50–718.88 bull FVG remains open beneath as the downside cushion, with 737.02 the key upside barrier and 686.36 only back in play on a loss of 715.60. Bias is neutral-to-cautious-long while price holds above 722.40; a clean hold above 737.02 confirms full trend reversal toward the 758.44 upper pivot, while a rejection back below 722.40 revives the bearish case. Invalidation: loss of 715.60 (through the bull FVG) kills the upside case and reopens 686.36.
